item.title: test(vitest): give config creators nameable return types
item.summary: test(vitest): give config creators nameable return types A vitest/vite type bump made inferred creator return types reach vite-internal names (TS4058/TS4082), failing check-test-types repo-wide. Annotate the scoped/extension config roots and the spread-rebuilding creators with ViteUserConfig; also drop an unused workflow read, mutating sorts, and an untyped record index left by 1f591bba562.
